en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 449 - It is narrated from Fadhl from Ibn Asbat from Hasan bin Jaham that he said:

A man asked Imam Musa Kadhim (a.s) about the reappearance and he asked in return: “Do you want most of it or shall I give you a summary?” “Would you give me a summary?” he said. “(It will be) when the standards of Qays are carried in Egypt and the standards of Kinda in Khurasan,” he replied.
